name: @avatark/narrative-interpretation
description: PLT-ADR-009 / STK-WO-009: derives non-authoritative interpretation candidates from narrative evidence. Not World authority, not Episode compilation, not narrative-runtime execution -- a derived, non-certifying boundary. Phase B connects one real Lane-1 evidence class (PlaceMemory.expectedPatternState) through the existing @avatark/narrative-ir-adapter, its one dependency; every other evidence class remains explicitly not-yet-integrated.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
